title: Fiction genres and non-fiction text types

steps.say: Fiction is an invented story. Non-fiction gives facts about real things.
Fiction has genres, such as mystery, fantasy, science fiction and historical fiction.
Non-fiction has text types, such as instructions, reports, recounts and persuasion.
Personal style uses I, we and you. Impersonal style states facts.

check.prompt: A story has dragons and a wizard. Which genre is it?

options.why: There is no puzzle to solve.

hints: Magic and imaginary creatures are the clue.
check.explanation: Dragons and wizards belong to fantasy.

check.prompt: Which text gives the steps for making a paper boat?

options.why: A poem is written in lines.
A diary is a personal record.

hints: Steps tell you what to do.
Which text type tells you how to do something?
